tools.name: radarr_search
tools.description: Search for a movie in Radarr. Returns matching movies with year, status (downloaded/missing), and TMDB ID. Use for questions like 'do I have Inception in Radarr' or 'search for The Matrix'.

tools.name: radarr_add
tools.description: Add a movie to Radarr's download queue. Use when the user says 'add Inception to Radarr' or 'download The Matrix'. Confirms before adding.

tmdb_id.description: The TMDB movie ID to add

quality_profile_id.description: Quality profile ID (optional, uses default if not specified)

monitored.description: Whether to monitor for this movie (default: true)

tools.name: radarr_calendar
tools.description: Show upcoming movies on Radarr's calendar — releases, downloads, etc. Use for 'what movies are coming up' or 'show Radarr calendar'.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 14)

tools.name: radarr_wanted
tools.description: Show movies that are monitored but missing (not yet downloaded). Use for 'what movies are still missing' or 'show wanted list'.

tools.name: radarr_quality_profiles
tools.description: List available quality profiles (useful before adding a movie so you know which profile IDs exist). Use when the user needs to know what quality profiles are available.
